title: How to become an ultralearner
coreMove: Convert ambition into one constrained project format, then test the plan with a pilot before committing fully.
sourcePressure: First projects should focus on one thing, use clear constraints, choose a full-time, fixed-schedule, or fixed-hour format, and run preparation through a pilot week. The source sidecar contains no named people, studies, institutions, places, dates, or artifacts for this chapter, so named source anchors must be omitted rather than invented.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Skipping straight from excitement to an oversized plan with no test of schedule, materials, or first week reality.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.domain: Hannah, a nurse choosing one wound-care credential instead of four ambitions
exampleSpecs.audience: a learner who has been mistaking motion for progress
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the next month produces visible evidence or another private feeling of effort
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Hannah cuts four nursing credentials down to one wound-care target and writes a pilot week around two real dressing-change observations.
